meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为项目识别语言、选定对应的语言服务器,给出安装命令和配置文件写法,并能用自带脚本检测安装状态、做一次真实诊断验证。
howto.when: 当你说“配置 LSP”“安装语言服务器”,或提到“no LSP server configured / server not installed”这类报错时触发。

say.text: 帮我在这个项目里配置 Python 的语言服务器
say.note: 会读取 Python 参考页,给出安装步骤和配置片段。

say.text: 我遇到 no LSP server configured,该怎么修复?
say.note: 会定位对应语言并检查服务器是否安装或已配置。

say.text: 比较 basedpyright 和 pyright 该选哪个?
say.note: 会对比内置选项并说明如何配置选择。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude determines the project language, picks the matching built-in language server, provides install commands and config snippets, and can run scripts to report install status and verify a real diagnostics roundtrip.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to configure/set up/install an LSP, reports 'no LSP server configured'/'server not installed', or asks to choose between servers/write LSP config files.

say_en.text: Help me configure the language server for Python in this project.
say_en.note: Reads the Python reference and gives install steps and config snippet.

say_en.text: I get 'no LSP server configured'; how do I fix it?
say_en.note: Locates the language and checks whether the server is installed/configured.

say_en.text: Should I use basedpyright or pyright here?
say_en.note: Compares the built-in options and explains how to configure your choice.
